proposedContracts.name: fails like native for the erosion-only coordinates option and out-of-range thresholds before opening outputs on every path

proposedContracts.name: copies width-1 planes with zero thresholds like native and refuses nonzero ones before opening outputs on every path
rejects unsupported layouts, budgets, malformed storage, invalid settings and cancellation explicitly

notes: No shared edits beyond the two registry lines were needed. Integer options reuse the existing packages/avfilter/src/activation/integer-option.ts helper, which scale and setsar already use.

Width-1 refusal is threshold-aware: a width-1 plane with threshold 0 is a native av_image_copy_plane and is accepted and proven; with a nonzero threshold native reads src+1 beyond the row, so it is refused in geometry (all paths) and repeated in frame.
The CLI differential test takes about 135 s on 4 CPUs (3900 native spawns plus the in-process runs).
Setup durations: submodule 34 s, npm ci 7 s, reference:build 137 s, baseline checks plus unit suite 116 s.
